concerns_addressed: Both scoped documentation files are present and contain evidence paths and executable verification commands.
Compatibility areas cover auth/RBAC, order, approval/invoice, delivery, payment, WhatsApp, analytics/finance/pipeline, web, and database/config.
Known gaps and assumptions are explicitly labeled rather than presented as verified facts.

strengths: Documentation is limited to the two files specified by the task; the commit has no extra files.
Existing role names are preserved and admin ops is explicitly mapped to admin.
Routes, response/status behavior, idempotency, concurrency, retry/lease behavior, source-of-truth boundaries, and baseline commands are documented with repository paths.
Production pilot activation, partner activation, two-week window, and 100-order outcomes are explicitly not claimed.
The structural documentation task does not incorrectly require production tests or claim external PostgreSQL results.

issues.description: The WhatsApp matrix row says 'an 200 duplicate response'; this is a wording/grammar typo and does not affect the compatibility contract.
